notes.title: NEW CONTENT AND CROSS-PLAY SUPPORT
notes.content:
[h1]Overlanders just got some sweet new updates. Let’s dive in![/h1]

[h1]30% DISCOUNT IS AVAILABLE NOW![/h1]

Two new game modes have arrived!
You want to play it tactical or just have a race all about speed? We got you covered.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Xc9GsJm.gif[/img]

More content in the Campaign mode, with added game modes and updated difficulties!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/i8pGaVY.gif[/img]

Overlanders is now on Nintendo Switch and cross-play is supported!
Play with more players all around the world.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/6oxAdbA.gif[/img]

More customization in Settings as you wanted! 
Full gamepad control, input rebind, all the good stuff is here!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31778483/de96c44b4c68aa8daa585aec9609a3c37d9bb78b.png[/img]

After our Switch release, we did a lot of optimizations and now you can enjoy some free performance improvements as well.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/sLPCnsa.gif[/img]

We hope you like the new stuff, and thanks for continuing to play and support our game!

notes.title: INTRODUCING OVERLANDERS
notes.content:
[h1]GAMEPLAY[/h1]
Overlanders is an aggressive hover-racer, where you chase the monster and his destruction is the end of the race.
Not just the speed, but weapons and tactics decide who will be the winner.

[h1]AI[/h1]
We are very proud of our AI system, we’ve developed a really professional and aggressive bot, which almost resembles the behavior of a real player. Weapon usage is based on a sophisticated logic. The AI will try to use the correct strategy given the weapons he has.

[h1]MULTIPLAYER AND CAMPAIGN[/h1]
Experience fast-paced multiplayer racing, with weapons, power-ups and more. Race online or practice in the campaign. 5 players per race.

[h1]VEHICLES[/h1]
You have 4 hover-racers at the moment. In addition to their appearance, their behavior and handling are different, so you will surely find the most suitable one.

[h1]SKINS[/h1]
The game contains 64 skins total, in categories (Rn-Down Style, Metallic, Legendary).

[h1]COMMON AND SPECIAL[/h1]
Each racer has 6 common weapons, which can be upgraded. In addition, they have three unique abilities, also upgradable to four levels.

Let’s see the racers:
[*][h1]COMET[/h1]
She mostly resembles a regular motorbike. Very small in size, especially compared to the others, but should not be underestimated. Its main advantage is acceleration and drifting.
Unique abilities: Shock Wave, Smoke, Mines

[*][h1]GOLIATH[/h1]
He’s a real heavy duty racer, despite its size, it is relatively fast, but slows down a bit in turns. Good combination and easily becomes your favorite. Due to its size, he handles collisions better than Comet, so it can be a good choice for a beginner as well.
Unique abilities: Double Torpedo, Invisibility, Smoke

[*][h1]BUFFALO[/h1]
This character is medium in size and he is the most balanced. 
Easy handling and good max speed. 
Unique abilities: Shock Wave, Invisibility, Smoke

[*][h1]FLUX[/h1]
For a novice player, he can be challenging, but for a more experienced pilot Flux can be a great companion. Slow acceleration, but if you navigate skillfully, the top speed will surprise you. Handles collisions very well.
Unique abilities: Invisibility, Smoke, Double Torpedo
[/list]
[h1]COMMON UPGRADES[/h1]
[list]
[*] [h1]BOOST[/h1]
Gives you extra speed. Useful when you want to catch up or escape from the enemy.
[*] [h1]TRAP[/h1]
Place a large trap on the track. Hard to avoid in turns and slows down who hits it.
[*] [h1]SHIELD[/h1]
Block all attacks. Useful when you hear the rocket behind you.
[*] [h1]COIN[/h1]
Free money! Easy way to get some bonus coins.
[*] [h1]GRENADE[/h1]
Quickly fire three grenades. Slow down other racers or damage the monster.
[*] [h1]TORPEDO[/h1]
Fire a rocket, tracking the enemy in front of you. Also deals damage to the monster.
[/list]
[h1]SPECIAL UPGRADES[/h1]
[list]
[*] [h1]DOUBLE TORPEDO[/h1]
Fire two tracking rockets. Eliminate two players or damage the monster.
[*] [h1]INVISIBILITY[/h1]
Blocks all damage and gives you extra speed. Useful if you want to win.
[*] [h1]MINES[/h1]
Scatter these mines on the track. Hard to see and very distracting if somebody hits it.
[*] [h1]SMOKE[/h1]
Place it on the track. Thick smoke will appear, that distracts racers in it.
[*] [h1]SHOCK WAVE[/h1]
Fire a strong pulse around you. Slow down all racers who are in range.
[/list]
[h1]TRACKS[/h1]
You have 14 tracks at the moment, which are played in 3 different environments. On these unique worlds, you can expect all types of weather and different times of the day. 
Race in the sunset, snow or night rain.

If you have any question, comments, ideas about the game, you can write a comment here on Steam forum, or any of our social media. ([url=twitter.com/OverlandersGame]Twitter[/url], [url=facebook.com/OverlandersGame/]Facebook[/url])
We would love to talk to you!

Hope to see you soon!
-Overlanders Team

notes.title: Introducing - Trapper
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31778483/e25d31447d108d2e4c19f2e36955a34b2da24e61.png[/img]

This is the third episode of our weekly series, where we introduce you the four vehicles you can play in Overlanders.
You have already seen the Heavy and last week you got to know the Assault. 

This week you can read about the third character, the Trapper.

This machine is the biggest from our crew. Two roles, driver and artillery, both under your control.
The Trappers main role is to try to slow down the target or make it incapable of damaging the others. 
Hooks, ropes, nets this guy has them all.

When playing Trapper, you should try to isolate your target from the others, then slow it down or make it stop completely while the others try to take it down.
Your role is important, you have to forge time for your friends to escape if the situation gets too hot.
With this powerful artillery you can also deal some real damage, how you play is your choice now.

[h1]Trapper has one weapon, that can fire various projectiles, mainly[/h1]

[list][*][b]Hooks, ropes, nets[/b] - to slow the target down
[*][b]Rockets, drones, bombs[/b] - to deal damage where needed
[*][b]Aerial projectiles[/b] - that can create isolating borders around the target or your friend[/list]

Thanks for reading our updates.
You can read about [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/779450/announcements/detail/1669019038133977801]Assault[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/games/779450/announcements/detail/3375882122130526356]Heavy[/url] as well (click on them)

You might want to also follow us on [url=twitter.com/OverlandersGame]Twitter[/url], if you want to see more pictures, work in progress informations and similar updates.

Next week we will introduce our last character, the Support.
See you later!

notes.title: Assault - The fastest
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31778483/cea49cc63411966f5276ce2dc3031669f64771e4.png[/img]

This is the second episode of our weekly series, where we introduce you the four vehicles you can play in Overlanders.

Last week you got to know the Heavy, this week you can read about the Assault.

This bike is the fastest and easiest to navigate and armed with quick firing weapons.
Assault can’t take a lot of damage, but he can navigate through every fight and escape if necessary. 
Assault has the ability to track down and find the enemy, deal reasonable damage and summon supportive actions to the team.

The main goal for him is to detect creatures, get really close to them to deal both aerial and powerful focused attacks.
He can boost up to very high speeds, leaving most of the creatures behind.

[h1]Assault has two main weapons.[/h1]
[list][*]A smaller rapid fire gun, with reliable range and damage.
This is the base weapon for the Assault

[*]The secondary weapon is a customizable slow fire weapon with high damage.

[*]The main selling point for the Assault is the variety of abilities, that can deal damage to multiple opponent and do many more things.
[/list]

Thanks for reading our updates.
You can follow us on [url=twitter.com/OverlandersGame]Twitter[/url] or [url=www.facebook.com/OverlandersGame/]Facebook[/url], if you want to see more pictures and similar updates.

Next week you will meet the Trapper.

notes.title: Introducing - Heavy
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31778483/3347df7599adc4f0d76a3c250e7225a2d6b640a8.png[/img]

This is the first episode of our weekly series, where we introduce you the four vehicles you can play in Overlanders.
First of all, the Heavy.

This bike is relatively fast and armed with the biggest and deadliest weapons of all.
Heavy can take a lot of damage, but you still have to be careful. He is not immortal.
When in combat, heavy can deal a lot of damage without being interrupted, but can't stay in the middle of combat for too long.

The main goal for him is to deflect the monster from the more vulnerable bikes, while dealing as much damage as he can.
He can boost up to high speeds, but not for a long time, so always watch for a way out of a bad situation.

[h1]Heavy has two main weapons.[/h1]
[list]
[*]A smaller rapid fire gun, that can attract the attention of the beast, but nothing more.
Not like his big gun. 
[*]The large guy on the front takes the biggest damage from the four bikes.
It's a multipurpose weapon, that can be configured for different play styles.
[/list]

Thanks for reading our updates.
You can follow us on [url=twitter.com/OverlandersGame]Twitter[/url] or [url=www.facebook.com/OverlandersGame/]Facebook[/url], if you want to see more pictures and similar updates.

Next week you will meet the Assault.

notes.title: Planets, monsters, bikes?
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31778483/40f2c39570e946af48a0c63a77efe6b3acee1b82.png[/img]

[h1]How many Planets to travel and explore?[/h1]
    We are planning to have 3-4 planets at launch. On all planets you will have multiple base locations, which you can explore as you level up and and complete the missions.
    You will progressively gain access to the missions, locations and planets.
    Each planet will have bigger and harder to defeat beasts, that can come alone or in a horde.

[h1]How is the gameplay like?[/h1]
    The main element of the game is a somewhat tactical hunting with the vehicles in fps mode. 
    You can hunt smaller creatures alone or team up with others to take on the bigger prey.
    Your will have to improve your weapons and vehicle to be able to fight on the next planet.
    Keep in mind that we will keep adding extra planets and base locations after the launch.

Feel free to comment below and ask us anything you want.
See you later!
[h1]-Overlanders Team[/h1]
